Sri Satyanarayana Swamy Puja Preparation Guide

Evening (Sandhya Kalam) or Pratah Kalam on Purnima • Duration: 2.5 – 3.5 Hours

1T-24 Hours

Mandapa & Altar Sanctification

  • •Thoroughly clean the northeast (Ishanya) corner of the home.
  • •Wipe the wooden altar (Puja Peeta) with Ganga jal.
  • •Arrange fresh mango leaves (Toranam) at the home entrance.
Items needed: Ganga Jal, Peeta Cloth (Red Silk), Mango Leaves (Mavilai)
2T-3 Hours

Prasad & Panchamrita Preparation

  • •Prepare Sapada Bhakshya (Suji Halwa with pure cow ghee, milk, sugar, banana, dry fruits).
  • •Blend honey, raw cow milk, fresh curd, ghee, and gangajal into a clean brass bowl for Panchamrita.
  • •String fresh marigolds and fragrant jasmine strings.
Items needed: Panchamrita dry kit, Pure Cow Ghee, Raw Camphor, Fresh Flowers
3T-45 Minutes

Kalasha Sthapana & Navadhanya Setup

  • •Spread uncooked rice mixed with turmeric (Akshata) on the wooden altar.
  • •Spread the Navadhanya (9 sacred grains) in cardinal planetary alignments.
  • •Fill the brass Kalasha with pure water, cardamom, clove, coin, and sacred nut.
  • •Place 5 mango leaves facing upward with the coconut crowning the vessel.
Items needed: Brass Kalasha, Crowned Coconut, Navadhanya Pack, Sacred Thread (Moli)
4Commencement

Prathama Deeparadhana & Sankalpa

  • •Light the twin brass Kuthuvilakku lamps with pure sesame or cow ghee.
  • •Invoke Lord Ganapati with Haridra (turmeric paste) invocation.
  • •Pandit and Yajamana chant the Sankalpa with betel leaves, supari, and akshata.
Items needed: Brass Diya Lamps, Cow Ghee Wicks, Bhimseni Camphor, Brass Bell

This guide provides preparation and procedural assistance. The actual Vedic Sankalpa, Katha recitation, and Arghya ceremonies are led by your family purohit or pandit.
